Tutorial Phase 30 Message: Country upgrades are essential to gain strategic advantage over your enemies. Each faction shares three common upgrades : AWFDS (a country fortification), Supply Center (which allows to buy units) and Power Plant (which doubles resource bonus). Plus, each faction has a unique country upgrade.
